Indicator 8 measures the proportion of adult ADHD treatment courses in which psychoeducation is initiated within 120 days. The 2024 data reveals significant variation across Danish regions and specific psychiatric clinics, with a national average of 36% (945 out of 2,648 cases) [^src1]. The established target for this indicator is 90% or higher, meaning that no region or clinic in the dataset successfully met the standard; all are recorded as having missed the target ("Nej") [^src1].

Among the regions, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] performed best with 50% (472 out of 940), followed closely by [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] at 49% (56 out of 114) [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] ranked lowest among the regions at just 18% (30 out of 163) [^src1]. When examining specific clinics, [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]] emerged as the clear leader, achieving 83% (39 out of 47) [^src1]. [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] also posted a strong result at 82% (122 out of 148), and [[pmi-klinik-for-depression-og-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]] reached 80% (4 out of 5), though its small sample size yields a wide confidence interval [^src1]. 

A notable outlier in the data is [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] (private hospitals), which recorded a 0% success rate (0 out of 10) [^src1]. While the national and regional figures show consistent shortfalls against the 90% threshold, the high-performing individual clinics demonstrate that the target is closely approached in specific local settings, even if not universally achieved. Because this comparison is based on a single dated section from 2024, no longitudinal trends can be established.

The complete 2024 and 2023 ADHD reports contain extensive additional material beyond Indikator 8, including introductory sections [^src2], methodological frameworks and background context [^src3][^src4][^src11][^src12], further regional and national data analyses [^src5][^src6][^src10][^src15], and extended discussions on other clinical indicators and quality assurance measures [^src7][^src8][^src9][^src13][^src14].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af voksne ADHD-behandlingsforløb med påbegyndt psykoedukation inden for 120 dage på regions- og klinisk niveau, og viser stor variation fra 0 % (privathospitaler) til 83 % (Tønder), med ingen region eller klinik der når udviklingsmålet på ≥90 %.
